extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comparison of two quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate with denominator of one.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent ratios
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratios that represent the same relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relationship where one quantity is a constant multiple of another.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unit rate in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number expressible as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number that cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Number line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of numbers in order.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distance of a number from zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest common factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Largest whole number dividing two numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least common multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Smallest common multiple of two numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrase involving numbers, variables, and operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Symbol representing an unknown or changing quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statement asserting equality of two expressions.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statement comparing quantities using greater than or less than.

extracted_concepts.name: Properties of operations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules such as distributive, associative, and commutative properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expression whose variable terms have degree one.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation whose graph is a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of a linear relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule assigning each input exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function whose graph is a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: y = mx + b
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Slope-intercept form of a linear function.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar triangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Triangles with equal angles and proportional sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relationship among side lengths of right triangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Same shape and size after rigid motions.

extracted_concepts.name: Rotation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rigid motion turning a figure about a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Reflection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rigid motion flipping a figure across a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Translation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rigid motion sliding a figure without turning or flipping.

extracted_concepts.name: Dilation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transformation changing size by a scale factor.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graph displaying paired data points.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Straight-line equation used to approximate data trends.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-way table
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Table organizing categorical data in rows and columns.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method for estimating likelihoods of outcomes.

extracted_concepts.name: Random sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Selecting samples so each member has equal chance.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Average value of a data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Middle value of an ordered data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Interquartile range
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spread between the first and third quartiles.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean absolute deviation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Average distance of data values from the mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Box plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Display showing median, quartiles, and outliers.

extracted_concepts.name: Histogram
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Bar display of frequency across intervals.
